deep_analysis:
Portfolio is FLAT (0 open trades) — no positions to steer, so this cycle is about pattern correction and one high-quality re-entry. Market regime is firmly BEAR: BTC at 81,686 sits BELOW EMA300 (81,991) for 761 consecutive minutes (~12.7h), continuum BELOW, both 15m and 4h scanners print SHORT_BIAS, and 87 of 123 scanned tokens are SHORT_BIAS vs 4 LONG_BIAS. Volume regime is LOW, velocity SLOW — this is a declining grind, not a panic dump, which favors fade-and-short setups over bottom-fishing LONGs.

The last 20 closes were a coin flip on count (10W/10L) but the losses reveal three verified failure patterns. First and worst: LONG at overbought RSI 80+. SEI LONG entered at meta_rsi 84.2 lost -5.2% (biggest single loss of the day), POL LONG at 85.0 lost -3.2%, RESOLV LONG at 80.0 lost -1.2%. All three died via hard_max_loss or atr_sl — the trail never armed because there was no trend to trail, only a pump that was already over. The WINNING side was SHORT or flat: ETC SHORT at RSI 73.3 won +6.1%, LTC SHORT at 65.2 won +4.9%. We keep longing tops in a bear tape.

Second: volume-buildup+ LONG is 0% WR (0/3, net -0.26 USDT) while its mirror volume-buildup- SHORT is 100% WR (4/4, net +0.41). Same mechanical signal, opposite side. The volume is building for a dump, not a pump — we're reading the setup backwards. The winning side is the short, and the signal family already proves it.

Third: direction-level bleed. LONGs over 24h: 22 trades, 32% WR, net -0.43. SHORTs: 17 trades, 41% WR, net +0.41. In a bear regime below EMA300, every long is a counter-trend trade against someone who is short and winning. No open positions means no profit-lock or staleness steers this cycle — the actionable work is to keep firing SHORTs aligned with the bear continuum and refuse LONG entries until BTC reclaims EMA300 with bullish linreg.
regime_context: BTC 81,686 below EMA300 (81,991) for 761 min / ~12.7h. Continuum BELOW. 15m + 4h scanners both SHORT_BIAS. Aggregate token scan: 87 SHORT_BIAS / 4 LONG_BIAS / 32 neutral — a broad, synchronized bear tape. Zscore NEUTRAL, velocity SLOW, acceleration slightly POSITIVE (a weak bounce inside the downtrend), volume LOW, linreg_direction LEAN_BEAR (15m and 1h slopes negative), market_phase DECLINING. Implication: SHORTs are regime-aligned and LONGs fight the tape. The acceleration-positive blip explains why several shorts at RSI ~50 got stopped (small bounces), but the higher-timeframe structure remains down — shorts entered at RSI 45-62 with ATR room keep working (volume-buildup- 4/4, pump-chain- net +0.26). Do not flip long until BTC reclaims EMA300 AND linreg turns bullish; the 1.3% ATR stop handles a reclaim cheaply if it happens.
